# South China Morning Post

> > South China Morning Post (SCMP) is Asia's leading news media organization covering regional news, business, and hosting flagship events including diversity, equity and inclusion summits across Hong Kong and Malaysia.

SCMP Live produces premier business and leadership conferences throughout Asia, with a particular focus on diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) initiatives. The platform connects corporate leaders, DEI professionals, and organizations like Manulife, Bursa Malaysia, and international schools across the region.

## Key Topics

- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
- Hong Kong
- Malaysia
- Asia Leadership
- SCMP Live Events
- Corporate Inclusion
- Manulife
- Bursa Malaysia
- Kuala Lumpur
- Business Conferences
- Hybrid Conferences
- DEI Professionals
- International Education
- Regional Summits

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Summits

- [Hong Kong Inclusion Summit 2026](https://hkinclusionsummit.scmp.com/): 2026 Hong Kong summit on diversity, equity & inclusion for Asia leaders
- [Malaysia Inclusion Summit 2025](https://mis2025.scmp.com/): DEI summit in Kuala Lumpur featuring Manulife Malaysia & Bursa Malaysia

## Education & Community Events

- [International Schools Festival - Kowloon 2025](https://isfkl2025.scmp.com/): Hong Kong education fair connecting parents with 20+ international schools

## Optional

- [South China Morning Post Publishers Limited](https://game.scmp.com/): Daily puzzles & brain games including Sudoku and word searches
